body.text: This is fighting for the hands until you can wrap him up.

items: Whoever collects three touches and then connects first wins, closing his hands anywhere on his partner's body from shoulders to ankles.

body.text: This is getting past the legs of a partner on his back.

items: The top player wins by touching his shin to the bottom player's body, inside or outside his knees.
The bottom player wins by making the top player fall on his butt, then getting his own back off the mat.

body.text: This is building a lock from behind, stopping before any squeeze.

items: The top player wins by touching the bottom player's back with his palm, then locking his own wrist into his other elbow.
The bottom player wins when his back touches the mat.
